_noteQ: Q (H-28G Evolution Turret) curated loop 51 (Cowork, user decision) as a FLAT per-second DoT via the new perSecondCalc mechanism, rather than left out of scope. HeimerdingerQ.mSpellCalculations 'Damage' (BaseDamage + TurretAPRatio) is the turret's per-SHOT number, resolved LIVE from the BIN so it tracks patch + Heimerdinger's AP (Hard Rule). It is reused here as the per-SECOND rate: perSecondCalc='Damage', scaled by the combo node's 적중시간 (UserHitDurationSeconds, clamped to maxDurationSeconds=6s). APPROXIMATION (honestly flagged): (1) the turret fires slightly FASTER than once per second in the early game, so per-shot≈per-second UNDERSTATES modestly (conservative for a kill calc); (2) the separate periodic 'DamageBeam' (BeamAPRatio) is NOT added -- only the basic turret attack is modeled; (3) 6s is an exposure-window clamp for how long a target realistically stays in turret range, NOT the turret's (effectively indefinite) lifetime. Tagged 'Zone' (escapable, target can leave turret range). Unset 적중시간 -> 0 damage, same honest default as other duration-scaled hits.

_noteW: W (Hextech Rocket Swarm) curated using ONLY the guaranteed first-rocket hit. HeimerdingerW.mSpellCalculations 'Damage' (BaseDamage + InitialDamageAPRatio) matches the wiki's 'Initial Rocket Magic Damage: 50/75/100/125/150(+55% AP)'. The ability actually fires a wave of 5 rockets that fan out, and a target CAN be hit by more than one ('Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first' -- 'ExtraHitDamage' = 'Subsequent Rocket Magic Damage' 10/15/20/25/30(+12% AP) per extra rocket, and 'TotalDamage' = 'Combined Total Non-Minion Damage' 90-270(+103% AP) is the BIN's own pre-summed Damage+4xExtraHitDamage aggregate assuming ALL 5 rockets converge on one target) -- but hitting more than the first rocket depends on the target's position relative to the fan spread, a variable/positioning-dependent quantity this model has no way to guarantee, so ExtraHitDamage/TotalDamage are deliberately NOT curated (same conservative-baseline convention as Gwen Q's mini-snip omission). This CORRECTS the previous auto-pick, which used 'TotalDamage' (the all-5-rockets-hit aggregate) as a count-1 hit -- overstating typical damage by up to 3x.
_noteRUpgrade: R UPGRADE!!! CURATED (loop 499). The old _noteR called this structurally impossible: the empowered numbers live on HeimerdingerR while the casts they belong to are Q/W/E, and the schema had nowhere to put them. That stopped being true when binSpell and extra slots landed - it is the same shape Hwei's nine muse casts use, a slot of its own resolving against another BIN object. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Heimerdinger, fetched 2026-08-21): R is a toggle that empowers the next basic ability and deals nothing itself, which is why R still has no hits. The three empowered casts are QUlt (H-28Q Apex Turret, 8 seconds rather than the base turrets indefinite uptime), WUlt (Rocket Swarm, initial 135/180/225 +45% AP then 19 smaller rockets) and EUlt (CH-3X Lightning Grenade, 100/200/300 +60% AP a bounce). Each MIRRORS the shape its base slot already uses so the two are comparable: QUlt is the same per-second turret rate on the duration knob, WUlt the same [one rocket, whole volley] distance range, EUlt a single impact. The auto flag is dropped - the note said it was kept solely because R was uncurated.

_noteR: R (UPGRADE!!!) confirmed to deal NO damage of its own, matching the prior loop's finding/hint. Per wiki: 'Toggle: Heimerdinger empowers his next basic ability for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast' -- R itself is a pure toggle/buff with zero cast-time damage; the empowered numbers ('QUltDamage'/'QUltDamageBeam' for the upgraded H-28Q Apex Turret pet, 'WUltDamage'/'WUltTotalDamage' for 4-wave Rocket Swarm, 'EUltDamage' for the upgraded grenade) are stored inside HeimerdingerR's own SpellData purely because that's where Riot's BIN groups UPGRADE!!!'s modified-ability data, but they only fire when the PLAYER LATER CASTS Q/W/E while the toggle is active -- not when R itself is cast. They also cannot be curated onto the Q/W/E slots either: FormulaInterpreter resolves a calc name against that SLOT's OWN SkillData.SpellCalculations, and these calc names live only in HeimerdingerR's SkillData, so a 'WUltDamage' calc attached under the W slot would fail to resolve at runtime (KeyNotFoundException) -- there is no schema-correct place to put this cross-slot toggle-empowerment mechanic. Left entirely uncurated; QUltDamage (turret-pet damage, same out-of-scope reasoning as base Q) and WUlt/EUlt (unreachable cross-slot calcs) are both legitimately unresolvable here, not merely unresolved by oversight.
